hook.name: EulerSwap
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a custom AMM curve backed by Euler Finance lending vaults. In beforeSwap, it computes quotes from a proprietary bonding curve, deposits input tokens into Euler vaults, and withdraws output tokens from vaults, returning a BeforeSwapDelta to handle pool settlement. Native liquidity positions and donations are blocked via revert.
